claims.quote: The false x-ray tetra, Hyphessobrycon simulatus, is a characid endemic to French Guiana, from the Maroni to the Oyapock/Oiapoque river basins.
Endemic to French Guiana, where it is known from the Maroni, Mana, Sinnamary, Kourou, Comté, Mahury, Kaw, Approuague and Oyapock/Oiapoque River basins.
